signals.title: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman declares humanity is 'now in the singularity'
signals.summary: Altman stated 'we are now in the singularity — this is the moment,' calling it the realization of what seemed improbable a decade ago. Multiple outlets and prediction markets confirm the statement.

signals.title: Altman sets goal: automated AI researcher by March 2028
signals.summary: OpenAI targets an automated AI research intern by September 2026 running on hundreds of thousands of GPUs, and a true automated AI researcher by March 2028.

signals.title: Altman publishes 'The Gentle Singularity' — claims event horizon crossed
signals.summary: Blog post argues the singularity will not arrive as a sudden rupture but as a gradual progression of increasingly capable AI systems. Claims the process of building digital superintelligence has officially begun.

signals.title: OpenAI's Codex approaches autonomous software engineering
signals.summary: Altman says Codex is 'so good' and admits difficulty imagining what creating software at end of 2026 will look like — signaling rapid capability acceleration.

signals.title: Additional U.S. destroyers arrive in CENTCOM AOR
signals.summary: Multiple independent sources confirm increased activity and force posture adjustments in a key chokepoint.

signals.title: Unusual pattern of strategic airlift into forward operating locations
signals.summary: Open-source tracking shows elevated tempo of heavy-lift flights consistent with contingency movement.

signals.title: Open model matches proprietary frontier on multi-step deception evals
signals.summary: Significant narrowing of the gap on safety-relevant benchmarks — accelerates capability diffusion risk.
